name: Truck Driving Game, by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
author: kelvinkit123
description: This is a Truck Driving Simulator Game, you are a Truck Driver, controlling the wheel and gas pedal to accelerate. By pressing the keyboard ARROW or WASD to control: (UP/W : forward) ; (DOWN/S : backward) ; (LEFT/A : turn left) ; (RIGHT/D : turn right). Make sure avoid the obstacles and don't full outside the road. Have fun and Enjoy the Game !! by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
